profile.setting: A classroom task with adult student volunteers from one department at a campus; not a live service queue.
profile.explanation: The paper compares task completion times and interpretation errors across two status notices using descriptive paired observations. It reports a small pilot, not a population effect estimate or evidence about real queue duration.

references.evidence_text: The study examined whether a queue-status prototype changed how quickly student volunteers could interpret a campus service status display in a classroom task. The study does not measure actual time spent in a live service queue.

## Analysis and results
Median task time was 72 seconds for the conventional notice and 58 seconds for the prototype. Four of twelve volunteers made an interpretation error with the conventional notice; two of twelve made an error with the prototype. The pilot reports descriptive paired observations and no significance test or population effect estimate.

turns.answer: Wala pa naabot ang six-month retention period, so plano pa ang deletion, dili pa completed. Ang among proposed process kay i-delete sa assigned researcher ang timing sheets ug backup copies, dayon maghimo og dated checklist nga adunay file category, deletion date, ug reviewer signature. feedback.summary: Maayo ninyong gilimitahan ang mga claim sa classroom task ug giklaro nga wala masukod ang aktuwal nga oras sa pagpila (empirical.md, Lines 4, 6). Natapos ang session kay gipahunong sa host human sa Q2; wala pa matuki ang Design, recruitment, and order; Measures and task consistency; Descriptive results and strength of evidence; Claimed contribution and practical reach; ug Limitations and scope of further evaluation.

strengths.text: Sa Q1, klaro ninyong giingon nga task completion time ra ang 58-second median kumpara sa 72 seconds, dili actual waiting time sa live queue. Sakto kini sa sakop nga giingon sa paper (empirical.md, Lines 4, 12).

Sa Q2, klaro ninyong gilahi ang plano sa paper nga mag-delete human sa unom ka bulan gikan sa inyong gisugyot nga deletion checklist. Gisulti usab ninyo nga wala pa maabot ang retention period ug wala sa uploaded paper ang checklist (empirical.md, Line 14).

improvements.text: Human sa Q2, gitapos sa host ang session, busa wala pa matuki ang nahibiling coverage topics. Andama ang mubo nga tubag bahin sa sample ug order, mga measure, limitasyon sa descriptive results, contribution, ug scope sa sunod nga evaluation.
